description: The first physical-reflex experiment opened the intended pre-fall route in every complete-Mission probe and advanced Program recovery on degraded-right from 6.06 to 5.00 seconds, but the old recovery route then retained learned authority for 3.70 seconds and the robot ended inverted. Isolate the causal variable by removing all learned authority after the Program enters recovery. Credit a later Task-target entry to the bounded actor interventions that preceded it in the same uninterrupted episode, so elite replay and checkpoint selection can consolidate a useful brace even though the fail-closed gate is correctly shut at the target crossing.
